verdict.rationale: First-party material documents MCP client support: users configure MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to add custom tools (gh-19), can connect new capabilities such as Imagen, Veo and Lyria media generation via MCP (gh-5), and can manage servers with the /mcp command (docs-3); the @github example (gh-22) shows an external tool being invoked. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of MCP configuration and transports, and independent or hands-on corroboration that plugged-in MCP tools work reliably.
